# Departments

Below you will find use case examples for different departments.

Regardless of your specific area, the general process remains the same:

1.  Identify documents relevant to your department
2.  Create a new notebook in NotebookLM
3.  Upload the selected materials
4.  Formulate prompts tailored to your team's needs
5.  Practice with real scenarios from your daily work


## Marketing

NotebookLM can support marketing professionals with campaign planning, brand positioning, and content analysis. Below you'll find practical examples of how various marketing functions can benefit from public documents and strategic prompts.

:::{.callout-tip title="Brand Management" collapse="true"}

**Use NotebookLM to:**

- Analyze your brand's language and tone of voice
- Compare your positioning with that of competitors
- Extract key statements or value propositions from a page

**Suggested Document:**

- [Kärcher About Us Page](https://www.kaercher.com/de/inside-kaercher/unternehmen/ueber-kaercher.html)

**Example Prompts:**

```md
What emotions or messages are emphasized on this page?
```

```md
How is the brand positioned in terms of innovation and user-friendliness?
```

:::

:::{.callout-tip title="Campaign Management" collapse="true"}

**Use NotebookLM to:**

- Summarize industry reports and identify campaign-relevant trends
- Generate messaging ideas based on audience insights
- Structure creative briefings based on strategic guidelines

**Suggested Approach:**

Use Gemini Deep Research to create a report. Upload this report to NotebookLM.


**Example Prompts:**

```md
What are the top marketing trends mentioned in the report?
```

```md
Which KPIs will become more important in 2025?
```

:::

## Sales

NotebookLM can help sales teams quickly grasp product materials, handle objections, and align their approach with customer needs. Use the following examples to explore NotebookLM for real sales tasks.

:::{.callout-tip title="Direct Sales" collapse="true"}

**Use NotebookLM to:**

- Extract key selling points from product brochures or websites
- Prepare objection-handling arguments
- Practice role-play dialogues based on FAQs or support cases

**Suggested Documents:**

- Yellow Files
- [Kärcher T-RANGE Product Page](https://www.kaercher.com/de/trockensauger-t-range.html)
- Internal sales cheat sheets (if available)

**Example Prompts:**

```md
List five customer pain points that this product solves.
```

```md
What are the strongest arguments for professional buyers?
```

:::

:::{.callout-tip title="Key Account Management" collapse="true"}

**Use NotebookLM to:**

- Summarize long strategy reports to tailor presentations
- Understand trends in the customer's industry
- Prepare decision-oriented management summaries

**Suggested Documents:**

Use Gemini Deep Research to create a report. Upload this report to NotebookLM.


**Example Prompts:**

```md
Which trends are most relevant for industrial customers in 2024?
```

```md
Summarize the barriers to B2B purchasing decisions mentioned in the article.
```

:::

## Technical Documentation

NotebookLM can revolutionize technical documentation by transforming complex technical specifications into user-friendly guides and multilingual content.

**Use NotebookLM to:**

- Transform technical specifications into user-friendly guides

**Suggested Documents:**

- Technical specifications
